title: Returned Payment Fees and Draft Re-presentment — Premium Billing Accounts Fee Schedule
content:
This fee schedule governs returned checks and drafts on Premium Billing Accounts.

**Schedule terms**
1. *Re-presentment count* — count of times a returned automatic draft is presented again before it is treated as unpaid.
2. *Re-presentment interval* — business days after a return on which the draft is presented again; 0 when not applicable.
3. *Returned-payment fee* — USD fee booked when a check or bank draft is returned unpaid (insufficient funds, closed account); 0.00 means no fee.
4. *Fee cap* — at most this many returned-payment fees in any rolling 12 months.
5. *Returns before AutoPay removal* — count of returned drafts within 12 months after which automatic draft is removed and the account must pay by check or card; 0 when not applicable.
6. *Arrangement after removal* — the arrangement the account is moved to when automatic draft is removed.

| Arrangement | Re-presentment count | Re-presentment interval (business days) | Returned-payment fee (USD) | Fee cap per rolling 12 months | Returns before AutoPay removal | Arrangement after removal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly | 0 | 0 | 25.00 | 2 | 0 | not applicable |
| Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly | 1 | 3 | 25.00 | 2 | 2 | Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly |
| Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill | 0 | 0 | 25.00 | 2 | 0 | not applicable |
| Cascade Individual Annual Prepay | 0 | 0 | 25.00 | 2 | 0 | not applicable |
| Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly | 1 | 3 | 0.00 | 0 | 2 | not applicable |
| Cascade Group List Bill | 0 | 0 | 35.00 | 3 | 0 | not applicable |
| Cascade Group Self-Administered Bill | 0 | 0 | 35.00 | 3 | 0 | not applicable |

**Reading the schedule.** The individual arrangements other than the exchange charge 25.00 per returned item, at most 2 times in any rolling 12 months; the two group arrangements charge 35.00, at most 3 times; Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly charges no fee (0.00). Drafts are presented again once, 3 business days after the return, only on Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly and Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly. A Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly account whose returned drafts reach 2 within 12 months loses automatic draft and moves to Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A group account on Cascade Group List Bill that has already been charged 3 returned-payment fees in the rolling 12 months is charged no fourth fee for a further return in that period; with 2 charged, a further return carries 35.00.
